name: Sync Sales Persons (create/update)
summary: Creates or updates sales person records. One row per person, matched by externalSalesPersonId (usually their email).
whenToUse: When you want to seed or refresh rep records (name, email) so leads/opportunities can be linked to them via externalSalesPersonId. Up to 300 per call.

body.hint: One row per person. externalSalesPersonId (the CRM ID — often the email) is required; add columns for email, firstName, lastName, etc.

response.description: Per row: status (created/updated/failed) and the record ID.

notes: Link leads or opportunities to a rep by setting their externalSalesPersonId field to the same value used here.
Sales person records are API-only — they don't have a page in the Marketo UI.
